speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia (APL). The peripheral smear findings of Auer rods (pink, needle-shaped inclusions) in immature cells with a markedly elevated white blood cell count are pathognomonic for this condition. Please confirm immediate initiation of all-trans retinoic acid (ATRA) and request flow cytometry to confirm the diagnosis.
